announcements.headline: Delay in publication of H1 2026 interim results
announcements.insight: Supply@Me Capital delays H1 2026 results. This follows June funding amendments, suggesting potential operational adjustments affecting shareholder timelines.

announcements.headline: Amendment to Nuburu On-Demand Funding Facility
announcements.insight: Amendment to the Nuburu On-Demand Funding Facility follows the June open offer warrant exercise. Shareholders should monitor funding terms.

announcements.headline: Exercise of Open Offer Warrants
announcements.insight: Supply@Me Capital is exercising open offer warrants. This capital action suggests a potential dilution event for existing shareholders.
